about_short_description.short_description: We enable game studio growth through playtest,acquisition & retention strategies, while offering gamers daily play-and-reward opportunities!

product.name: Playtesting Services
product.description: A service that connects game studios with qualified playtesters to collect gameplay data and player feedback on unreleased or live games.

product.name: AI-Powered Playtesting Workspace
product.description: A collaborative platform that centralizes playtesting activities, providing secure build management and AI-driven analysis of player feedback and gameplay data.

product.name: Research Advisory Services
product.description: Expert user researchers assist in interpreting player feedback and gameplay data to provide actionable development priorities.

product.name: User Acquisition Services
product.description: Performance-based campaigns and influencer marketing to attract and engage players who match the game’s target audience.

product.name: Playtester Platform and App
product.description: A platform and app that enable gamers to participate in playtests, provide feedback, and earn rewards for testing unreleased games.
